blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Japanese former world title challenger Kyosuke Takami will add international flavor to the upcoming “Fist of Fury 13” as he sees action in a special attraction bout this Saturday, November 14, at the Fuente Osmeña Circle in uptown Cebu City. The inclusion of Takami was announced by event promoter Lorenzo “Chao” Sy of Chao Sy Promotions ahead of the official weigh-in scheduled tomorrow at the Cebu City Sports Center (CCSC). The 24-year-old Tokyo native is currently ranked No. 1 in the World Boxing Association (WBA) flyweight division. He is also ranked No. 6 by the World Boxing […]...
